business_problem: Orbweaver needed to replace an expensive, fragile DocumentDB plus Elasticsearch stack for multi-million-part search and procurement workflows.
solution_summary: Orbweaver consolidated its parts-search platform onto MongoDB Atlas and MongoDB Search on Atlas to support a digital-native procurement workflow for the electronics industry. The company loads supplier and catalog data with millions of parts and up to 40 attributes per part into Atlas, then uses integrated Lucene-based search to power its Parts Search API, quoting, sales automation, and customer-supplier integration services. By removing the separate Elasticsearch and ETL layers, Orbweaver simplified operations, improved resilience, and made indexing dramatically faster, with new indexes across gigabytes of data taking under a minute. That design cut latency by more than 70 percent while also lowering cloud spend and engineering overhead.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores supplier, catalog, quoting, and integration data for Orbweaver's platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Search on Atlas
solution_components.role: Indexes part attributes and powers the Parts Search API for buyers and manufacturers.

data_flow: Supplier part files and product attributes are loaded into MongoDB Atlas, indexed by MongoDB Search on Atlas, and served through the Parts Search API to buyers and manufacturers without a separate ETL or search stack.
business_outcome: Orbweaver lowered latency by more than 70%, cut cloud spend, and removed ETL and search-stack complexity from its parts-search platform.
metrics: Part catalogs easily span into the millions with each part having up to 40 different attributes.
